parsed.elsewhere_quote: Since every connected multigraph has \(e_C\ge v_C-1\), this component has \(e_C=v_C-1\) and is a tree (an isolated vertex counts as a tree).
parsed.explanation: The selected connected component satisfies \(e_C<v_C\); combined with \(e_C\ge v_C-1\), this gives \(e_C=v_C-1\). The write-up then explicitly identifies it as a tree. A connected multigraph with a loop would have at least \(v_C\) edges, so no loop can occur in that component. Thus the needed fact is both implied and stated through the tree conclusion.
